title: 64 days to election: Peter Obi assures Nigerians their sacrifice for a New Nigeria won’t be in vain at Lagos town hall
summary: With 64 days until 16 January 2027, Peter Obi held a town hall in Ikeja, Lagos, assuring supporters that their sacrifices will not be in vain, condemning an attack on the venue, and pledging unity, security, 10,000 MW electricity, primary healthcare in every ward, and a shift from consumption to production. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the message. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 65 days to election: Peter Obi pledges no Nigerian goes to bed hungry as Oluwadara Kehinde advances local agenda
summary: With 65 days until 16 January 2027, Peter Obi held a town hall in Makurdi, Benue State, pledging that under his administration no Nigerian will go to bed hungry, while uniting and securing the country and creating opportunities for youth. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon focused on youth empowerment, agriculture, education, accountability and infrastructure. Share the national vision with the local agenda. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 66 days to election: Share Oluwadara Kehinde’s people-centred agenda as Peter Obi advances unity and security message in Plateau
summary: With 66 days until 16 January 2027, supporters are encouraged to engage friends and family with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s homegrown, transparent agenda for Yewa North / Imeko-Afon — youth empowerment, agriculture and value addition, entrepreneurship and small business, education and skills, accountable representation, and infrastructure and rural welfare. Nationally, Peter Obi held a town hall in Jos, Plateau State, pledging to unite Nigeria, secure the country, return IDPs to their homes, and shift from consumption to production. Share the local agenda paired with the national vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 67 days to election: Share recent Joga-Iboro engagement as Peter Obi advances accountability and productivity message
summary: With 67 days until 16 January 2027, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues ward-level mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon, including recent work captured in the gallery from Joga-Iboro. Nationally, Peter Obi has been active with engagements in Enugu, Awka and a visit to LoveWorld Expo in Ogun State, while pressing for accountability on public resources.
